## Required

Eight fields: trip/set/catch IDs; species; fate category and reason; sampling method; fish count.

## Available

There are 8,703 catch records. IDs, species, broad fate and positive counts are recorded.

The 1,350 grouped weights all come from self-reporting trips; 1,123 have specified processing and method.

Most weights are visual estimates. They must not become individual fish weights.

## To decide

Validate species and fate correspondences, then establish the actual sampling method.

Do not infer a discard reason from species alone, or treat retention as evidence of sale.

An empty sheet is structurally possible only without specimen descendants; the reporting rule remains open.
